name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.4 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 6 visits over 78 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.3 days starting 2025-07-21, at wavelengths from 0.89 to 4.65 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
